title: FAA UAP reports, batch 16 (237UAP00389 - 237UAP00454)
doc_notes: This is a batch of FAA UAP incident reports; most entries are distant sightings, but three reports describe close-range encounters with specific physical characteristics or associated technical issues.

encounters.summary: UPS 913 reported a white torpedo-shaped object passing 500 feet below their left wing while at FL240.
Flexjet 359 reported a UFO 10,000 feet above their aircraft at FL450, accompanied by autopilot and attitude reference system issues.
encounters.quote: PIC reported attitude reference system and auto pilot issues

encounters.summary: N926FM reported a shiny missile-shaped object climbing through FL360 with a smoke trail.
